hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Compute the xor sum of all elements across the entire array.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: If the cumulative xor sum is already zero, zero modifications are necessary.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Otherwise, modifying any single existing element to cancel the total parity reduces the full xor sum to zero in exactly one operation.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def minOperationsToZeroXOR(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    xor_sum = 0
    for x in nums:
        xor_sum ^= x
    return 0 if xor_sum == 0 else 1
```

complexity.notes: Single pass computes full XOR parity to check if zero or one operation is required.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying combinations of operations is redundant given parity cancellation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that a single element replacement suffices if XOR is non-zero.
